newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct state sector investment up 18.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct state sector investment up 18.6 pct.

text.p: Fixed-asset investment by China's state-owned enterprises totalled 949.7 billion yuan in January to October, up 18.6 percent over the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
Of the total, fixed asset investment in technical renovation showed a year-on-year rise of 14.3 percent in the period. Investment for capital construction was up 11.8 percent, the bureau said.
Investment in property development maintained strong growth of 34 percent in the first 10 months compared with the year-ago period, it said, without giving further details.
It did not give figures for October alone.
